skill.name: knowledge-base
skill.description: Manage a structured Markdown knowledge base for project concepts, guides, decisions, indexes, and glossaries.
skill.summary: Create and maintain project knowledge documents from templates, scans, discovery reports, indexes, and glossary generation.
skill.author: Dwsy

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from TypeScript template literals, Markdown command examples, hidden-directory examples, and high-entropy Chinese text. No prompt injection or active child_process execution was found, but decision names are not path-sanitized before writeFile.

remediation.issue: Decision document names can contain path separators and traversal segments.
remediation.suggestion: Apply the same strict filename sanitizer used for concept and guide names, reject dot segments, and verify the resolved path stays under docs/knowledge/decisions.

remediation.issue: The script imports child_process without using it.
remediation.suggestion: Remove child_process, promisify, and execAsync unless command execution is implemented with fixed commands and arguments.

remediation.issue: Generated command examples reference a hidden home-directory install path.
remediation.suggestion: Document the path as an example or make it configurable to reduce false security signals and portability issues.

semantic_findings.description: The decision creation path builds finalFilename from the user supplied name after only replacing spaces, then passes it to join and writeFile. A crafted name with path separators and dot segments can write outside the decisions directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The concept and guide branches sanitize file names, but the decision branch leaves slashes and dot segments in the name. The unsanitized value reaches targetPath and writeFile in the same branch.

content.value_statement: Project knowledge becomes scattered across code, reviews, and private memory. This skill creates structured Markdown concepts, guides, decisions, indexes, and glossaries.
actual_capabilities: Initializes docs/knowledge with concepts, guides, decisions, external, and index files.
Creates concept, guide, and decision Markdown files from included templates.
Scans source files for class, interface, type, enum, and struct names.
Generates a knowledge index and a concept glossary from Markdown files.
Discovers common technical directories and suggests related documentation topics.
Searches knowledge documents and prints matching file paths with line context.
limitations: The scanner uses heuristics and can miss domain concepts without type declarations.
It writes files under the current working directory and needs path hygiene.
It does not verify external references or factual accuracy.
It requires Bun or a compatible TypeScript runtime.

use_cases.title: Onboard New Engineers
use_cases.description: Create a readable map of project concepts, guides, and decisions for new team members.

use_cases.title: Capture Domain Language
use_cases.description: Turn recurring terms, abbreviations, and business rules into stable concept documents.

use_cases.title: Review Documentation Gaps
use_cases.description: Discover common project directories and generate a checklist of missing knowledge articles.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize a Knowledge Base
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a repository without project documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the knowledge-base skill to initialize docs/knowledge for this project, then summarize the folders it created.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Concept Entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concept document for [term] in [category]. Include a clear definition, context, misconceptions, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Find Documentation Gaps
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan documentation work from the repository structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run discovery for this repository and identify the highest value concept and guide documents to add first.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Onboarding Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan the repository, generate suggested concepts, update the index, and produce a short onboarding reading path.

output_examples.output: The skill creates concepts, guides, decisions, external references, and an index under docs/knowledge.

output_examples.input: Discover documentation gaps for a web application.
output_examples.output: The skill lists detected technical directories and suggests concept and guide topics for each area.
The skill prints matching knowledge files with short line context for each match.

best_practices: Review generated suggestions before creating documents.
Keep concept definitions short, direct, and tied to project usage.
Regenerate the index and glossary after meaningful documentation changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat scan output as complete domain analysis.
Do not use untrusted text directly in file names.
Do not store secrets or private customer data in generated documentation.

faq.question: Does this skill change existing documents?
faq.answer: It refuses to create a document when the target file already exists. Index and glossary commands overwrite generated files.

faq.question: Which runtime does it need?
faq.answer: The documented commands use Bun to run the TypeScript script.

faq.question: Can it scan every programming language?
faq.answer: No. The scanner checks selected source extensions and looks for common type and class declarations.

faq.question: Does the script make network requests?
faq.answer: No network request is implemented in lib.ts. External references are managed as Markdown knowledge entries.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata marks Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing generated docs?
faq.answer: Review file paths, suggested topics, and any sensitive project details before committing generated documents.
